summary: Official Lucide icons across the tray, folder rows and tray menu.
changelog: Folder rows use official Lucide icons with a 2 px stroke at 22 px (issue #100).
Tray status icons use official Lucide cloud glyphs with a 3 px stroke (issue #100).
Tray menu items use Lucide external-link and log-out icons (issue #100).
Old custom tray SVGs and the unused per-state glyph variants have been removed.
